intent: Ensure the committed-diff audit validates the subject of the code commit when a manifest-only follow-up commit carries its audit, and add a two-commit regression test.
reviewed_by: Assistant review of the exact audit implementation and regression-test diff; repository-owner review remains possible
commit_subject: Validate audited commit subject across manifest follow-up

requirements.text: When HEAD only updates the audit manifest, CommitGuard must validate the reviewed subject against the preceding audited code commit, not the metadata follow-up commit.
A regression test must construct a code commit followed by a manifest-only commit and prove the audit passes only against the audited commit's subject.

scripts/commit_intent_audit.py.necessity: The audit compared the code diff from HEAD^ but compared its subject to HEAD, so valid metadata follow-ups were always rejected. Subject selection must use the same audited commit.

scripts/test_commit_guard.py.necessity: The two-commit regression fixture protects the exact metadata-follow-up behavior and catches future mismatch between the diff target and subject target.
